messages:
Maria: ok looping everyone in — post-incident thread for last night's pager (kv-serving hotset -> eviction cascade -> degraded inference paths). want to lock a postmortem time and surface runbook gaps. TL;DR: customer-facing errors for ~18m in us-west-1, many requests rerouted to fallback models, higher token cost.
Ana: thanks. quick timeline from oncall notes: 01:12 alarm -> 01:14 oncall ack -> 01:15 mitigation (scale up private pool) started -> 01:25 KV evictions peaked -> 01:30 fallback routing triggered -> 01:40 latency normalised. impact window ~18m as Maria said.
Jake: adding that the model fallback path saved many requests from failing but increased token spend by ~2.3x for that window. rough cost math in the logs.
incident-bot: created postmortem ticket INC-2026-42 and a follow-up board card: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-42 :spiral_note_pad:
Maria: goal here: 1) schedule 1hr postmortem (not blame, facts + action items), 2) decide on runbook edits, 3) follow up with customers who saw errors. propose Thu 09:30 PT or Fri 14:00 PT. who can attend?
Lina: I can do Thu 09:30. I want to present the KV metric dive.
Ana: Thu works for me. I'll bring SLO/timeline data and pager logs.
Sam: Fri 14:00 is better for product folks (we're deep in sprint Thu). If Thu is a blocker for ops, I'll send product notes afterwards.
Kevin: support saw ~7 customers open tickets referencing "service degraded"; I can draft a customer-facing post explaining fallback behavior and ETA for changes. assign to me for outreach.
Maria: ok lock Thu 09:30 PT — Ana, Lina, me, Kevin. Sam will get the notes after. Incident-bot if you can, add the calendar invite and attach the ticket.
incident-bot: calendar event created "INC-2026-42 postmortem" Thu 2026-03-19 09:30 PT, attendees: Maria, Ana, Lina, Kevin. Link: https://cal.redwood.com/event/5sDf9
Jake: action items I propose now: A) short-term: add a temporary alert threshold to detect eviction surge earlier + increase KV node autoscale window, B) medium-term: investigate hot key redistribution + per-tenant KV rate limiting, C) runbook: clarify oncall mitigation steps for fallback routing and when to trigger capacity burst.
Maria: assigning A -> Ana (alert tweak + autoscale), B -> Jake (hotkey analysis), C -> Lina (runbook edits). Please ack in-thread when you start.
Ana: ack. I'll open a PR to ops-config for the alert change and capture prometheus query and rationale. snippet below:```promql
sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (instance) > 50
```I'll also extend autoscale cooldown from 30s to 90s as a stopgap.
Lina: ack. I'll update the oncall runbook section "kv-eviction-thrash" with a clear play: detection -> quick scale -> confirm fallback routing -> contact infra for burst. I'll include exact cli cmds and runbook checkbox. planning a PR to docs repo.
Jake: ack. I'll start a hotspot analysis job over last 72h to see tenant distributions and hot key candidates.
Kevin: ack. I'll draft the customer note and post in #support-distro for review.
Maria: two small runbook wording things we want to add: 1) explicit threshold to skip automatic fallback for internal tests, 2) a short checklist for handoff to day oncall (state, mitigations, open actions). Lina pls capture.
Ana: one more ops note — during the handoff at 02:00, the oncall message didn't include the KV eviction graph link; let's make that part of the handoff template. I'll add the grafana link macro to the runbook.
Maria: perfect. I'll consolidate action items and update the Jira ticket with owners + due dates: A (Ana) due EOD tomorrow, B (Jake) due next Wed, C (Lina) due in 4 business days, customer outreach (Kevin) due EOD today.
Jake: FYI I'll also instrument a low-overhead metric to detect prefix-level cache pressure; will include an example exporter and PR link in the postmortem.
Sam: when we do the postmortem please include a short blameless summary for CS + Legal — we need plain language for enterprise customers. Kevin, happy to review your draft.
Kevin: thanks Sam. will share draft before EOD.
Maria: last ops housekeeping: test the new runbook flow in next week's chaos window before we rely on it for production. Marking that as a follow-up action in INC-2026-42.
incident-bot: reminder set for postmortem pre-read 24h before meeting.
Maria: great thread. I'll post the postmortem notes after the meeting and open the runbook PR reviews as they come in. if anyone runs into blockers for their actions, ping here or DM. :thumbsup:
